I am farming here in Iringa, in the Southern Highlands where the rains are good and maize grows well. This small plot of 0.11 hectares is just one of my plots — my main maize fields are bigger, but on this one I intercrop with beans to feed my family. I will use a little DAP at planting and topdress with urea if I can afford it, because the soils here respond well, but I cannot afford much on such a small plot. I will use manure from my few animals, plant improved seed since my neighbors have shown it yields better, and rely on rain since I have no irrigation. Most of the work I will do myself with my family.
